description: P3 coupling. The consumer pin carries the outcome discriminator — Blocked (`stage: validation`) — the antecedent that keys the open-plan-pr Do Not bullet. WHICH Worker Report outcome blocks the PR is the claim-carrying antecedent; pinning without it leaves the outcome rekeyable with the suite green. Honest residual: the bullet is not adjacent to its `## Do Not` header, so the pin cannot carry the negation context; polarity inversion that keeps these bytes intact is outside what a presence pin can see.

source.pattern: Open PR only when: plan complete, validation passed, version bump included if required, branch pushed

consumers.pattern: open PR if the Validation procedure returned the Worker Report — Blocked (`stage: validation`)
